333-5231-8207.easyPrerequisites: Ferocity of the Hunt attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.

Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.

When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

Repeat.

Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.

7-1824-2530-7349.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.

Repeat.

Resolve the Naga Fleshcrafter trigger, causing you to look at the top seven cards of your library and put Naga Fleshcrafter onto the battlefield as a copy of Ao.
Repeat from step 2.

Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability
Repeat.

When the lands enter the battlefield, Nissa triggers that many times, adding {G} for each land that entered the battlefield this way.

If you control nine or more lands, this combo will net infinite mana due to Nissa's trigger.
